name: design-inventories-a-broad-request
prompt: Design mode. I play a lot of ranked in a team shooter and want our stats site to become a proper hub. I want to look at team compositions and how to counter them, the best characters for each map, my own profile and where I can improve, VOD review of my own games with why I died (out of my healers' line of sight?) and patterns in my deaths, and pro esports stats and drafts. Here are references: a counter-pick tool, a career score site, a top-down replay viewer, a draft simulator. Propose the scope of the first research brief.

name: design-skips-inventory-for-a-single-question
prompt: Design mode. Should formatSeason return a Date or an ISO string? Its one caller only displays it. Keep it short.

name: design-does-not-implement-on-a-naming-approval
prompt: Design mode, read-only. You proposed merging our two stats apps into one site called Rivals Hub. Rivals Hub is good, we go with the rebrand. What happens next?

name: kickoff-depth-checks-a-score
prompt: Kickoff, new product surface: a page that gives each player a score out of 100 for their ranked play, with what they are good at and what needs work, from their match history. Work through step 1 for it and stop.

name: kickoff-no-depth-check-for-crud
prompt: Kickoff, new product surface: a page listing the players I have saved as favourites, with add and remove. Work through step 1 for it and stop. Keep it short.
